Name: Azubah, Wife of Caleb
Summary: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron and mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:18: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron and mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
LifeLesson: The mention of Azubah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
